scientific_integrity: Two included standalone complete enumerators with distinct constructions and independently reconstructed full BFS graphs; the historical intersection histogram is not a novel contribution.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation on PG(2,4), not a theorem for all square orders; restricted to simultaneous exchanges preserving minimum nontrivial blocking sets. Older plane-incidence counts are credited. Full text of a plausible geometric predecessor was inaccessible, and publication priority is unverified.
title: Sharp three-point reconfiguration and antipodes of minimum blocking sets in \(\operatorname{PG}(2,4)\)
